Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes.  No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.

One Perseverance-type six-wheeled rover with white instrument body, gray camera mast, black and gray wheels and visible jointed suspension; dusty rust-red ground under a pale tan sky. No astronauts, plants, faces or flags.
